item.description:
ShabuBox 2.8.1

A small update. It fixes a crash on launch caused by some PDFs, makes sure one problem document can never crash the app over and over, and gives the local chat model its own place in Settings so it works properly without Apple Intelligence.

Fixed

  • Crash a few seconds after launch — some PDFs with damaged internal formatting made ShabuBox crash while reading their headings. Because the document never finished being read, the app crashed again on every launch. These PDFs are now read safely, and their text is still indexed.

Safer reading

  • One document can't keep crashing the app — if a document ever crashes ShabuBox while it's being read, and does it again on the next launch, ShabuBox stops reading it and treats it as unreadable. The rest of your library carries on as normal. The next update tries that document again, in case it includes a fix.

Chat without Apple Intelligence

  • The local model shows in Settings — Settings → Chat now shows the status of the model that runs on your Mac, not just Apple Intelligence. What it shows follows your Answer with choice.
  • Download, test and remove it — you can download the local model from Settings, check it works with Test chat model, and remove downloaded models to free up disk space.
  • Clearer wording — Apple Intelligence status is now labelled "Apple Intelligence", so it isn't confused with the local model.

Notes

  • Nothing to do after updating. Your library isn't re-read or changed.
